interpretation: The accepted local real-SWAP response points establish that the physical outward exchange derivative is equal in magnitude and opposite in sign to +u/dt to numerical precision. The earlier status-4 first scan point is not admissibility evidence because status 4 is CANDIDATE_BUSY; a replacement clean G06 scan is required for any head-envelope claim. F-GC44's ordinary two-iteration closure starts essentially at the fixed point and therefore does not by itself qualify finite-perturbation stability of the positive surrogate.

admissibility_correction.mechanism: The historical test called trial(href) and left that candidate live before the first local-scan point. The -2e-6 m call therefore returned CANDIDATE_BUSY before the corrector executed. The finally-discard then cleared the candidate, so later scan points were independent.
admissibility_correction.effect_on_tangent_claim: NONE. The physical tangent estimate used accepted clean points after the candidate was discarded.
admissibility_correction.replacement_qualification: G06 fresh-process fixed-grid scan preregistered in docs/research/GC_FIXED_INTERFACE_GLOBALIZATION_PREREGISTRATION.md
